text:
emma (Comms): Quick follow-up from the postmortem: we need a clear publish flow for customer summaries and a firm owner for the redaction checklist. Prefer someone from SRE for technical redactions.

liam (SRE): I can own the checklist. Will include rules for logs, hostnames, and credentials. Need legal on the consent flow if we plan to quote customers.

nina (Customer Success): Timing ask: initial customer summary within 72 hours, with a small "what this means for you" snippet. CS wants copy we can paste.

harper (Legal): 72h is acceptable. For RCAs with any customer-identifying info, legal review is required before release. I'll draft a brief consent & sign-off procedure.

ops-bot: Reminder: create incident action item IN-6021 with 72h due for customer summary.

emma (Comms): Proposed short status copy (single sentence) and 72h summary outline posted below. Please comment quickly so we can lock language.

liam (SRE): Short status example OK. For the 72h outline, include: impact, mitigation performed, interim protections, next steps + owner, and a CS-ready blurb.

nina (Customer Success): Add a line "If you need assistance, contact <support-link>" and the 3-line "for customers" blurb.

harper (Legal): For the redaction checklist: include a consent_flag, examples of disallowed content (raw customer IDs, full request/response pairs), and a sign-off chain: SRE -> Legal -> Comms.

liam (SRE): I'll add a small automated query to the postmortem template to surface similar incidents in the past 180 days and include a "recurring-pattern" checkbox. That helps decide proactive outreach.

emma (Comms): Good. Action list I'm assigning: liam: redaction checklist (48h), emma: status + 72h template (24h), harper: consent & sign-off doc (72h), nina: CS quick-reuse snippets (5 business days).

liam (SRE): :+1: I'll open the PR and include example redactions.

harper (Legal): :+1: I'll include a short appendix with sample customer consent text.

nina (Customer Success): :+1: Will prepare snippets and a reuse guide.

emma (Comms): Filing tasks and will ping each owner separately. Leaving thread open for any edge cases (regulated customers, on-prem installs). Tag me if you see one.

ops-bot: Task created: IN-6021 (customer-summary-followup) 172h due for initial summary.
